1. General

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Read the file as text (semicolon-separated, CRLF line endings)
raw_read <- read_delim(
  file = "_raw/GSE162746_Raw_counts_collected.csv.gz",
  delim = ";",
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
)
problems(raw_read)                 # should be empty

raw <- raw_read |>
  rename(row_id = 1)               # first header is blank; give it a name

# 2. Sample metadata: first three rows hold time, stimulus and donor
meta_rows <- c("time", "stimu", "sample")

sample_info <- raw |>
  filter(row_id %in% meta_rows) |>
  pivot_longer(-row_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "value") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = row_id, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), str_trim)) |>
  rename(stimulus = stimu, donor = sample) |>
  mutate(
    stimulus = recode(stimulus,
      "RPMI"                  = "unstimulated",
      "Candida-albicans"      = "C_albicans",
      "Aspergillus-fumigatus" = "A_fumigatus",
      "Rhizopus-oryzae"       = "R_oryzae"),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("4h", "24h"))
  )

# 3. Gene count matrix: keep only Ensembl gene rows
counts <- raw |>
  filter(str_starts(row_id, "ENSG")) |>
  rename(gene_id = row_id) |>
  mutate(across(-gene_id, ~ as.integer(str_trim(.x))))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(counts$gene_id), !anyNA(counts))

# 4. Select Candida and RPMI, and give each sample a readable name
selected <- sample_info |>
  filter(stimulus %in% c("C_albicans", "unstimulated")) |>
  mutate(group = if_else(stimulus == "C_albicans", "Candida", "RPMI")) |>
  arrange(group, time, donor) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  mutate(
    sample_no = row_number(),
    new_name  = paste0("Sample", sample_no, "_", group)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# 5. Metadata tables, one per group
candida_meta <- selected |>
  filter(group == "Candida") |>
  select(sample_id, time, donor, new_name)

rpmi_meta <- selected |>
  filter(group == "RPMI") |>
  select(sample_id, time, donor, new_name)

print(candida_meta, n = 20)
print(rpmi_meta, n = 20)

# 6. Count matrix with the readable column names
counts_named <- counts |>
  select(gene_id, all_of(selected$sample_id)) |>
  rename_with(
    ~ selected$new_name[match(.x, selected$sample_id)],
    .cols = -gene_id
  )

# 7. Save
dir.create("data_clean", showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(counts_named, "data_clean/counts_candida_rpmi.csv")
write_csv(candida_meta, "data_clean/metadata_candida.csv")
write_csv(rpmi_meta,    "data_clean/metadata_rpmi.csv")
write_csv(selected,     "data_clean/metadata_all_selected.csv")
```
